per_view.notes: Plain gray cylinder with flat blunt ends, no nose taper, tail cone, or hump. Wing is a thin flat edge-on plate with no dihedral. Single boxy nacelle under belly, not four. Vertical tail is an unswept dark rectangle; no horizontal stabilizers. Nose strut plus clustered ball wheels on thin sticks. Dashed window line present, roughly consistent.

Plain grey tube with blunt untapered nose and tail, no upper-deck hump. Single boxy nacelle under a thin flat wing plate; only one engine visible. Vertical tail is an unswept rectangular slab; no horizontal stabilizers. Dashed window line present with small cockpit mark. Nose-gear wheel plus a mid cluster of tiny wheels on thin struts; monochrome grey scheme.

Head-on: four dark-inlet nacelles hang under completely flat slab wings with zero dihedral or visible airfoil. Fuselage cross-section is a plain circle with no upper-lobe hump; two dark rectangles suggest cockpit windows. Vertical fin is a bare thin pole; no horizontal stabilizers visible. Nose gear plus only two main struts. Coherent all-grey scheme, clean assembly.

Slender gray tube with flat disc nose, no upper-deck hump—only tiny black blocks near nose top. Wings are flat untapered unswept slabs passing through the fuselage; four cylinder nacelles hang beneath them without clear pylons. Tall rectangular fin, no horizontal stabilizers. Small nose strut only. Square window row present; coherent gray scheme.

Slender grey tube with blunt flat ends, no nose or tail taper. Wings are flat unswept rectangular slabs, no dihedral or taper. Single crude vertical fin slab; no horizontal stabilizers. No engine nacelles anywhere. Tiny pin-mounted wheels dangle under mid-body. Evenly spaced dark window dashes present; small black block atop forward fuselage, no hump.

Plain gray tube with flat blunt nose disc, no hump anywhere. Wing is a dark flat slab mounted atop the fuselage with some sweep but no taper/dihedral. Three visible cylinder engines, one hung under the forward fuselage. Rectangular unswept fin, no horizontal stabilizers. Single tiny nose wheel plus two mid bogies. Window line present.

Slender grey tube with a completely flat nose disc; cockpit reads as two rectangles on the flat cap plus black boxes on the crown. No hump. Wings are flat untapered slabs without dihedral; four cylindrical nacelles hang below. Fin is an unswept rectangle; no horizontal stabilizers visible. Nose wheel plus sparse tiny main wheels. Consistent square window row.

critic.fix_suggestion: Improve 'Partial-length upper-deck hump' (mean 0.71/10). Target the 8 anchor: distinct partial-length upper deck starting at the nose and blending down within roughly the front third of the fuselage; then the 10 anchor: iconic 747 hump: starts at the cockpit, smoothly faired into the crown, ends around one-third of the length, with a visible cockpit region on the upper lobe.
